```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(l1ou) # this needs to be downloaded from github
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(geiger)
library(dplyr)
library(phytools)
library(plyr)
#library(coin)
library(Momocs)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

library(ggrepel)
```

# Load PCA data and volume dataset
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load both datasets
pca_df <- read_csv("./Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv")
master_df <- read_csv("./Results/Volume/Volume.csv")

# Standardize species names for matching
pca_df <- pca_df %>%
  mutate(species = str_to_lower(str_trim(species)))

master_df <- master_df %>%
  mutate(species = str_to_lower(str_trim(species)))

# Merge by species
combined_df <- left_join(master_df, pca_df, by = "species")

# Inspect
head(combined_df)

```

# Plot PCA scores with volume
```{r, label="plot PCA", echo=F, message=FALSE}

# Remove NAs for plotting
plot_df <- combined_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1_mean), !is.na(avg_volume_estimated))

# Identify 5 largest volumes
top_vol <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_volume_estimated)) %>%
  slice(1:5)

# Identify 5 smallest volumes
low_vol <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(avg_volume_estimated) %>%
  slice(1:5)

# Identify 5 lowest PC1
low_pc1 <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(PC1_mean) %>%
  slice(1:5)

# Identify 5 highest PC1
high_pc1 <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(desc(PC1_mean)) %>%
  slice(1:5)

  # Combine all for labeling
label_df <- bind_rows(top_vol, low_vol, low_pc1, high_pc1) %>%
  distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE)  # remove duplicates

```

```{r, label="plot PCA with outliers", echo=F, message=FALSE}

# Create plot with connecting lines from labels to data points
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1_mean, y = avg_volume_estimated)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, color = "#2C77B8") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", aes(label = paste(..r.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")),
           label.x = min(plot_df$PC1_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 
           label.y = max(plot_df$avg_volume_estimated, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
           size = 5) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = species),
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.5,
    nudge_y = 0.05 * max(plot_df$avg_volume_estimated, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1 (Spore Shape Axis)",
    y = "Estimated Spore Volume (µm³)",
    title = "Extreme Taxa on PC1 and Volume Axes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Save plot
ggsave("PC1_vs_Volume_TopBottomLabels_withLines.jpg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r, label="plot PCA with outliers", echo=F, message=FALSE}

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = avg_volume_estimated)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,                      # Number of bins; adjust for resolution
    fill = "#2C77B8",               # Color of bars
    color = "black",                # Outline of bars
    alpha = 0.8                     # Transparency
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Estimated Spore Volume",
    x = "Estimated Spore Volume (µm³)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("Volume.jpg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
